corrections.note: PDF only says 'news articles from various categories'; 20 is the standard dataset size (record notes already flag this).
PDF only says '50k users' reviews for movies'; binary sentiment is standard knowledge, not stated.
The PDF describes Booleanization only for the TM-AE (One Billion Word) input; the classification datasets' encoding is not stated (Table III implies negated literals for IMDB).
Generator described only by its parameter names; that the data are Boolean is plausible but not stated.

notes: Classification results (Tables I-III) are single numbers per setting with no run count, epochs (Tables I-II), split or validation stated; the abstract headline 90.62% IMDB is the best of the Table I s-sweep evaluated on the reported (test) accuracy, so the headline is test-selected, but each table row itself is just one sweep point -> selection_on_test left not_reported. Which TM variant is used for classification is not said beyond footnote 1 (TM with Boosting of True Positive Feedback); clause scope (per class vs total) not stated. Table III: 'counted the number of original and negated features present in 25 epochs of 50 positive weighted clauses' read as training for 25 epochs and inspecting 50 positive clauses. State-space experiments on One Billion Word (no numeric results): N = 2048, u = 25, epochs 5/100/200 with T = 3200, s = 5.0 (Fig. 4); 25 epochs with s in {3,10,20,40,100} (Fig. 5), T in {2,20,75,200,5000} (Fig. 6); Fig. 8 s in {1,5,20,100}; Fig. 9 T in {2,20,200,3200,5000}. Figures are not readable as text. Embedding dimension of the single-word TM-AE is not given (embedding = set of weighted clauses). All record result values match Tables I-III.
